::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/organization/model_prices/source"}
#docs
When `held` is true, a sync changed prices sharply and waits until the source keeps them for 6 hours; bills use the last prices until then.

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `model_price_source`. One of `model_price_source`. |
| `source` | `string` | Where the model price source comes from. |
| `url` | `string` | The model price source's URL. |
| `licence` | `string` | The model price source's licence. |
| `checked_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The checked time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `last_success_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The last success time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `check_error` | `string` | The model price source's check error. |
| `upstream_version` | `string` | The model price source's upstream version. |
| `held` | `boolean` | The model price source's held. |
| `next_check_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The next check time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `providers` | `array of string` | The model price source's providers. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The source state. |

#request

```bash [Request]
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
